value.rationale: The natural macroscopic root-density statistic and the natural extreme long-gap statistic have different fluctuation scales; knowledge of their marginals alone is insufficient for simultaneous inference. The result identifies their limiting independence and quantitatively bounds residual dependence for any rare-gap indicator, allowing joint prediction of total coverage and exceptional empty stretches. The bound uses the same local-neighborhood quantities already intrinsic to the deposition model, rather than an arbitrary sliced statistic.
